note: The original study describing 12 SPAX11 patients with TUBA4A p.Glu415Lys across two families notes oculomotor signs and specifies that dysarthria occurred only 'sometimes'.

evidence.text: The discovery study reported two families (one with 11 affected individuals and one with a single patient) harboring the TUBA4A p.Glu415Lys variant, noting ocular movement abnormalities such as nystagmus and broken smooth pursuit, while dysarthria was present only 'sometimes'.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: ocular movements (nystagmus, broken smooth pursuit), and sometimes dysarthria.
